# Services Agreement

[]{.comment-start id="0" author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-03-02T09:15:00Z"}The
Provider shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and
care.[]{.comment-end id="0"}

## Fees

The Customer shall pay the Fees within []{.comment-start id="1" author="Grace Author" date="2026-03-02T10:40:00Z"}thirty days[]{.comment-end id="1"} of receipt of a valid invoice.

## Liability

[]{.comment-start id="2" author="Ada Reviewer" date="2026-03-03T08:00:00Z"}Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.[]{.comment-end id="2"} The total liability of either party is capped at the Fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
